title: Ziff Davis Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Ziff Davis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZD) (“Ziff Davis” or “the Company”) today reported unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. “With the successful sale of our Connectivity business, our significant share repurchases, and our robust free cash flow, Ziff Davis is in a very strong financial position,” said Vivek Shah, CEO of Ziff Davis. “We are focused on deploying capital strategically to maximize long-term shareholder returns.” SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS During the second quarter of 2026, the Company completed the sale of its Connectivity business. The results of the Connectivity business are classified as discontinued operations for all periods presented in this press release. Unless otherwise noted, all amounts, percentages, and any discussion in this press release reflect the results from continuing operations, except for the Statements of Cash Flows and Free cash flow, which are presented on a combined continuing and discontinued operations basis.
